comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper opening limit; PR-1800 inserts an oil-feed sleeve with its radial passage registered.
comparison.physical_skill: Driver/wrench countertorque differs from tight coaxial insertion with rotational port alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies lock retention through repeated motion; PR-1800 verifies released supported seating and an unobstructed oil-passage gauge envelope for one second.
comparison.reason: PR-1800 explicitly ends before locking, so it does not test preservation of a setting during locknut tightening or subsequent cycling.
